title: Story premise EDU041: The Pronoun With Two Owners
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: Whose bag is actually missing? Takeaway/theme: An explicit noun can resolve ambiguity when a pronoun has multiple possible referents.
description: A courier must deliver a note saying Alex told Sam that their bag was missing, but cannot tell whose bag it means. Replacing the ambiguous pronoun with the intended name unlocks the correct route.
